about: A real client fortnight (27 September to 10 October 2026, send Sunday 11 October), redacted: the client's repository is private, so names, product and domain are replaced and everything else is kept as it was: every entry's title, line, merge time and order, the did-log notes, the uptime incident record, five distinct PageSpeed mobile runs, the search and visits figures, and the hand-written config. The ## Briefing blocks on #42, #56, #63 and #66 are the ones an author would add; the PRs carry none.

kind: visible
title: Your home page opens faster on phones
outcome: Phones and tablets skip the intro video and go straight to your planner. Desktops show a short animation beside the main card in place of the full-screen cover.

entries.forClient: We updated your site's error monitoring settings after moving it to our own account.

entries.title: Launch worker: move the sales floor to 18 November 2026
entries.forClient: The date the planner can go on sale has moved to Wednesday 18 November. Nothing changes on the website yet, and sales stay closed until you confirm the date.

entries.title: chore(guards): take the contrast maths from @domandigital/craft 0.18.1
chore: adopt the DD Framework rulebook
Add the six-page free sample PDF
entries.forClient: Six pages from the planner are ready to send to anyone who joins your list, so they can read a little before deciding. Please check you are happy with these six pages being shared; nothing goes out until you say so.

entries.title: Move email from Loops to Resend, with designed emails
entries.forClient: Your emails move from Loops to Resend and now carry the Willow & Wren look: cream background, the wren mark, your colours, signed "Sam W". Nothing is sent until you have read and approved each one.

entries.title: Ignore env and token files
entries.forClient: A small housekeeping change that stops password files from ever being saved alongside the website code. Nothing changes on the site.

entries.title: Move the launch to Wednesday 13 January 2027
entries.forClient: The planner's on-sale date moves from 18 November to Wednesday 13 January 2027. Your launch emails now carry the new date, and the Christmas ordering line is gone from the gifting email.

entries.title: chore(sentry): use the new org name for source-map uploads
Daily reminder for printer orders waiting to be paid
entries.forClient: Each morning you'll get one email listing any orders that are waiting to be paid at the printer, with a button to open the printer and pay them. On a day when every order is paid, no email is sent.

entries.title: feat(astro): email through Resend on the Worker
entries.forClient: The new, faster version of your site will send its emails through Resend too, in the same Willow & Wren design, and will send the morning reminder of orders waiting to be paid at the printer. Nothing changes on the live site yet.

entries.title: Astro port on Cloudflare Workers (draft, not deployed)
entries.forClient: Your website now has a faster version that looks and works the same: pages load with almost no waiting on phones. It is not live yet. We will test payments and switch over only when you're happy, and we can switch back within minutes.
